name: md_broken_links
description: Scans all .md files under a docs directory for broken relative links (missing file or missing heading fragment), writes a sorted unique JSON array of "<file>: <target>" to an output file, and returns the count and list.
whenToUse: When asked to check docs for broken relative Markdown links; re-run after docs change.

docsDir.description: Docs dir relative to project root

out.description: Output path relative to project root

provenance.reason: docs link check requested repeatedly as docs are rewritten
